meta.author: LS
meta.description:
多配方工厂
MultiCraft


[white[]]一个内含了多个支持json配置的建筑基类的库模组，包含以下内容：


多配方工厂
	（支持物品，流体，电力，热量，载荷输入输出（
对于建筑载荷的输入输出与单位载荷的输入，可以简单将其看作为种难以搬运的物品，而对于单位输出，由于能力限制，作者不得不设置成在有单位输出时强制设置单位载荷的容量为1并设置工厂的朝向以使单位可以正常输出
（简单点讲，单位输出会让工厂（在执行那个配方时）表现的像一个serpulo式的单位工厂）
（同时，在执行有单位输出的配方时，支持指令的控制（表现的像一个serpulo式的单位工厂一样：）
））））

	支持为每个配方单独设置环境加成，另外，也支持将配方设置成分离器模式，此时会将配方中作为输出的物品以类分离器的行为随机输出（
是的，只针对物品输出，你问作者为什么只处理物品？因为原版分离器就只对物品输出随机，虽然准确的讲他只能输出物品：）
）

	（自动为每个配方生成一个虚拟建筑（以工厂本身贴图为配方虚拟建筑贴图）
并允许为每个配方单独设置解锁条件，并会在配方有单独解锁条件时自动将其挂载在所属建筑的子节点（同时也支持手动配置、修改配方的节点位置）
，也允许单独在地图规则中手动禁用一个配方（通过在地图规则的禁用建筑中查找这个配方并禁用它））

多配方Erekir式组装厂

	（我知道这看上去有点重复，但是显然Serpulo的单位工厂跟Erekir的单位组装厂是两种建筑，如果S星的单位工厂尚且能通过用多配方工厂替代，E星的单位组装厂则只能单独处理）

	（当一个多配方工厂处于一个模块等级时，可以选择不高于当前组装厂模块等级的所有配方进行单位生产，并允许同一模块等级有多个配方）

全方向物品与流体桥
	（这个应该不需要额外描述）

流体分类器
	（如同物品分类器那样，不储存流体，直接运输
（为了攻破不储存流体、同时朝两侧运输、同时运输来自不同方向的多种流体（由于多种液体不能储存在同一管道中，来自同一方向的多种液体显然是不存在的，故而未单独处理与测试）不同的问题作者尝试了很久，最终不得不使用了每帧改变运输方向运输的方式，这导致流体分类器只有360/s的流体运输速率））

除了分类器之外所有类型的混装（同时运输物品与液体）的物流元件
	（也包括前述的全方向桥类，此外，对于溢流门，采用了路由器的方式运输流体）

焚化分类器
	（简单点讲，是焚化炉与分类器的结合体，不过通电时所有不焚烧的物品都会朝前输出，这是特意设计的）

（这是赠品）不限速度的装卸器

	（如其名字所说，能以超高速运输的装卸器，实测速度至少能到600000,不过，作为警告，显而易见，以过高速度运行的装卸器会导致游戏卡慢，甚至卡死）

	[red[]]（加入伟大的装卸器神教吧！！！）


[white[]]A library mod containing multiple building base classes that support JSON configuration, including the following content:

MultiCraft
	(Supports item, fluid, power, heat, and payload input/output
(for building payload input/output and unit payload input, it can simply be treated as an item that is difficult to transport.
For unit output, due to capability limitations, the author has to force the unit payload capacity to 1 and set the factory's orientation
when there is unit output so that units can be output normally
(simply put, unit output makes the factory behave like a Serpulo-style UnitFactory while executing that recipe)
(also, when executing a recipe with unit output, it supports command control
(behaving like a Serpulo-style UnitFactory ：）
)))))

	Supports setting environmental bonuses individually for each recipe.
Additionally, recipes can be set to Separator mode, in which the items output by the recipe are output randomly like a Separator
(yes, only for item output. You ask why the author only handles items?
Because the vanilla Separator only randomizes item output, although to be precise, it can only output items ：）
))

	(Automatically generates a virtual building for each recipe
(using the factory's own sprite as the recipe virtual building's sprite)
and allows setting unlock conditions individually for each recipe.
When a recipe has its own unlock condition, it will automatically be mounted under the parent building's child node
(manual configuration/modification of the recipe's node position is also supported).
It also allows manually disabling a recipe in map rules
(by finding and disabling this recipe in the map rules' banned blocks))

MultiCraft Erekir-style Assembler (I know this looks a bit repetitive, but obviously Serpulo's UnitFactory and Erekir's UnitAssembler are two different buildings.
If Serpulo's UnitFactory can still be replaced by MultiCraft, Erekir's UnitAssembler can only be handled separately.)

	(When a MultiCraft UnitAssembler is at a module tier, it can select all recipes up to the current assembler module tier for unit production, and multiple recipes are allowed at the same module tier.)

Omnidirectional Item and Fluid Bridge
	(This should not need additional description.)

Fluid Sorter
	(Like an item Sorter, it does not store fluids and transports directly
(To address the three distinct issues — no fluid storage, simultaneous bidirectional transport,
and concurrent transport of multiple fluids from different directions，
(As multiple fluids cannot be stored in a single conduit,
and multiple fluids arriving from the same direction is inherently impossible,
this scenario was not separately implemented or tested.)
the author spent a long time iterating on solutions,
and ultimately had to adopt a mechanism that alternates the transport direction every frame.
This limits the Fluid Sorter to a fluid transport rate of only 360/s.)

All types of mixed (transporting items and liquids simultaneously) logistics components except the Sorter

	(Also includes the aforementioned omnidirectional bridge types.
Additionally, for the OverflowGate, fluids are transported in a Router-like manner.)

Incinerator Sorter
	(Simply put, it is a combination of an Incinerator and a Sorter,
but when powered, all items that are not incinerated are output forward. This is intentionally designed.)

( This is a bonus ) Speed-Unlimited Unloader
	(As its name suggests,
an Unloader that can transport at ultra-high speed. The measured speed reaches at least 600,000.
However, as a warning, obviously, running an Unloader at too high a speed will cause the game to lag, or even freeze.)

	[red[]](Join the great Unloader cult!!!)
